title: RunnerHello
description: POST /api/runners/hello: what a runner reports about itself. Every field is optional; the server clips or drops values it does not accept and ignores unknown fields. A runner says hello at start, after a re-connect and every 30 s while paused.

runnerVersion.description: The runner's own version (stored clipped to 64 characters).

vramMb.description: GPU memory, MB. Kept only when 0 < vramMb < 10000000.

maxQuality.description: The highest quality this runner trains. The server lowers it to what the reported trainer and VRAM support (ultra needs gsplat).

memoryBudgetMb.description: Host memory the runner may use, MB. Kept only when 0 < value < 10000000. From runner protocol 1.1 the server offers 'splat-prepare' / 'splat-finish' jobs only when it covers the job's requiredMemoryMb.

brushVersion.description: Brush version (Brush runners only; shown when trainer is absent).

trainer.description: 'gsplat' or 'brush' (case-insensitive); anything else is stored as unknown.

trainerVersion.description: Sent by the Python runner; the server does not read it.

paused.description: The owner paused this runner: it takes no new jobs. Null from runners that do not report it.

capabilities.description: Job kinds this runner serves (see $defs/capability). The server keeps known names only (trimmed, lower-cased, de-duplicated). Absent, null or no known name: the runner counts as 'splat' only.

texturesMemoryMb.description: Blend memory budget for textures jobs, MB. Kept only with the 'textures' capability and 0 < value < 10000000. A textures job is offered only when it covers the job's requiredMemoryMb.

quality.description: Splat quality profile, lowest to highest.

capability.description: A job kind a runner may advertise. 'splat-prepare' / 'splat-finish': added in runner protocol 1.1 (blocwerk staging-o7, prs #239/#240; not on main yet).
